text.p: These are the leading stories in two Algerian newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 7,747 candidates for the parliamentary election are criss-crossing the country to try to convince voters about their programmes.
- Pledges to improve security and purchasing power dominate candidates' platforms.
- Contenders for the election of 380-seat National Assembly, focusing on grim assessements of the Algerian situation, fail to rekindle hope among electorate.
